title: 2D Transient Conduction (FEM)
desc.intro: This simulation represents transient heat conduction in a two-dimensional plate with fixed (Dirichlet) boundary conditions on the top and bottom edges. The temperature evolves in time until it reaches the steady state.
desc.method: We use the Finite Element Method (FEM) with a Delaunay triangulation for the spatial discretization and the Crank-Nicolson method for time integration. The thermal properties of the material (k, ρ, cv) can be adjusted.
